decisions.context: Scope and complexity of conditional expressions
decisions.decision: Implemented a minimal evaluator stub returning false for non-empty expressions to defer complex expression parsing and event hooks.
decisions.rationale: Plan requested conditional unlock system but expression language and event bus were undefined; a stub keeps scope small and allows later integration.

decisions.decision: Created abstract SkillNodeEffect with Apply/Remove to defer concrete implementations.
decisions.rationale: Effects vary widely; providing an abstract base satisfies the deliverable while keeping changes minimal.

decisions.context: UI prefab creation in headless environment
decisions.decision: Added an Editor utility `CreateSkillTreePrefabs` to generate placeholder UI prefabs inside Unity Editor rather than creating binary prefab assets here.
decisions.rationale: This workspace cannot reliably create Unity prefab binary assets; an editor script offers a one-click way to create prefabs inside Unity and keeps repository text-based.
